sources.title: Gobierno del Estado Plurinacional de Bolivia

capital.evidence_quote: Sucre is the constitutional capital; La Paz is the seat of the executive and legislative branches

currency.evidence_quote: The Bolivian Boliviano (BOB, Bs) is the official currency of the Plurinational State of Bolivia

timezone.evidence_quote: Bolivia operates year-round on Bolivia Time UTC-4 without daylight saving time

sources.title: DELAPAZ - Distribuidora de Electricidad La Paz

voltage.evidence_quote: Standard domestic electric supply across Bolivia is 230V 50 Hz (with 115V in limited older La Paz zones)

frequency_hz.evidence_quote: Grid frequency throughout Bolivia is standard 50 Hz

plug_types.evidence_quote: Wall outlets generally accept flat two-pin Type A and round two-pin Type C plugs

police.evidence_quote: Dial 110 for Radio Patrulla emergency police assistance across Bolivia

sources.title: Ministerio de Salud y Deportes Bolivia

ambulance.evidence_quote: Call 118 for emergency medical assistance and ambulance dispatch

fire.evidence_quote: Dial 119 for emergency fire and rescue services

general.evidence_quote: 911 operates as an integrated dispatch number in departmental capitals

tourist_police.evidence_quote: POLTUR provides dedicated visitor protection in La Paz and major archaeological centers

source.title: US Department of State Travel Advisory

advisory_headline.tr: Bolivya'da periyodik protestolar ve yol barikatları (bloqueos) görülebilir; seyahat rotaları önceden teyit edilmelidir.
advisory_headline.en: Exercise increased caution in Bolivia due to potential civil unrest, strikes, and highway roadblocks.
advisory_headline.de: Erhöhte Vorsicht wegen gelegentlicher Streiks, politischer Kundgebungen und Straßenblockaden.
advisory_headline.ru: Проявляйте повышенную осторожность из-за периодических забастовок и перекрытий междугородных трасс.
advisory_headline.es: Actúe con mayor cautela debido a bloqueos de carreteras y manifestaciones sociales periódicas.

mobile_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median mobile broadband download speeds in Bolivia reach approximately 26.5 Mbps

fixed_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median fixed broadband download speeds measure 34.0 Mbps

esim_sim_notes.value: Entel (state telecom) has by far the widest rural and Altiplano coverage, essential for Uyuni expeditions. Tigo is popular in Santa Cruz. Altitude sickness (soroche) pills should be taken upon arrival in La Paz (3,640m).
esim_sim_notes.evidence_quote: Entel provides the most comprehensive cellular network reach across remote Bolivian tourist circuits

source.title: Empresa Estatal de Transporte por Cable Mi Teleférico

religion.value: Roman Catholicism syncretized with indigenous Andean beliefs (Pachamama veneration)
religion.evidence_quote: Catholic ceremonies are interwoven with Andean offerings to Mother Earth (Pachamama)

festivals.value: Carnaval de Oruro (UNESCO Masterpiece of Heritage), Gran Poder in La Paz, Fiesta de la Candelaria in Copacabana
festivals.evidence_quote: The Carnival of Oruro showcases iconic Diablada dances and centuries of indigenous folklore

legal_cultural_warnings.value: Coca leaves are legally chewed (acullico) for altitude sickness in Bolivia, but taking coca leaves or coca tea bags out of the country on international flights is strictly illegal under international narcotics conventions. Roadblocks can halt intercity buses unexpectedly.
legal_cultural_warnings.evidence_quote: Exporting unprocessed coca leaves across international borders is prohibited by international treaties

tipping.value: Tipping is modest; leaving 5-10% in sit-down restaurants is customary. In casual comedores or market stalls, tipping is not practiced.
tipping.evidence_quote: A 10% gratuity is standard in mid-range and fine dining establishments
